scripts.db:shell: docker compose exec postgres psql -U postgres -d tareas
scripts.migrations:new: sh -c 'if [ -z "${NAME}" ]; then echo "Usage: NAME=migration_name bun run migrations:new"; exit 1; fi; docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)/apps/backend/internal/database/migrations:/migrations" migrate/migrate create -ext sql -dir /migrations -seq ${NAME}'
